sentences.japanese: ここから遠くまで行けるボートが欲しいです。
sentences.english: I want a boat that will take me far away from here.

sentences.japanese: 国王はいつも自分を褒めるおべっか使いにうんざりしていたので彼らを遠くへ飛ばした。
sentences.english: The king was tired of his sycophants always praising him, so he sent them away.

sentences.japanese: バカンスに行くのが待ち遠しい。
sentences.english: I can't wait to go on a vacation.

sentences.japanese: 遠からず私が正しいと納得しますよ。
sentences.english: You will soon be convinced I am right.
